title: إبطال الأدلة المتأثرة
rule:
Applies when: When relevant candidates or environments change.
Invalidate affected evidence and rerun necessary checks; do not treat old evidence as proving a different candidate or environment.
rationale: دليل على مرشح سابق قد يخفي عيباً في المرشح الحالي. PROVISIONAL_OWNER_REVIEW
reviewCadence: Owner review before activation and after material changes
